stem.text: A negatively charged oil drop is held stationary, equidistant between two plates connected to a high voltage supply, as shown.

stem.alt: Two horizontal parallel plates with a drop between them labelled oil drop, connected by wires to a supply with terminals marked + and −.

stem.text: Which change would **not** increase the upward electrical force on the drop?

A.text: decreasing the distance between the plates whilst keeping the drop equidistant from them

B.text: increasing the amount of negative charge on the drop

D.text: moving the drop closer to the positive plate
